character: Resort town on the Italian side of Mont Blanc at the southern end of the Mont Blanc tunnel. The lift-served area has two sectors, Plan Chécrouit and Val Veny facing Mont Blanc, and the Skyway Monte Bianco cable car gives access to high-altitude off-piste terrain (reference).
